data.name: V-Grid Energy Systems
data.description: VGrid Energy Systems is a California-based clean energy company operating modular "Bioserver" biomass gasification units that convert agricultural waste (primarily pistachio shells) into renewable electricity and biochar. The company is Puro.earth-certified and sells CORCs, with its biochar sequestering ~2.94 tCO2e per ton, and markets retail biochar/bio-liquid products under the Persist and Karrikaid brands.
